## What this adds

<!-- Adding a key, or retiring one. Nothing else belongs in this repository. -->

- [ ] Adding one publisher key
- [ ] Retiring one key with a signed revocation

## Submission terms

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and I accept it for this submission.
- [ ] I hold the private key for the `publicKey` I am submitting, and I generated it myself.
- [ ] The `publisher` name does not impersonate another person, project, or organisation.
- [ ] I place this entry in the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal.

## Checklist

- [ ] The file name is the fingerprint inside the file
- [ ] The file is unmodified as the manager wrote it
- [ ] No existing file is changed or deleted
- [ ] Nothing outside `keys/` or `revoked/` is touched
